job.title: Inhouse Consultant SAP C/4HANA Sales, Service, Marketing (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Java, Spring & API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, data-migration pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, and end-to-end integration. Proven techno-functional consulting: requirement analysis, user-story creation, customisation and production support in international, agile environments. Strong CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and AI-assisted development experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Inhouse Consultant SAP C/4HANA Sales, Service, Marketing
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Intertime AG’s focus on shaping digital sales and e-commerce processes. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems and driving global e-commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: **Integration Design**
bullets.text: Designed and implemented complex integration pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) linking product master data across SAP ERP, MDM and SAP Commerce, ensuring data consistency for worldwide storefronts.

bullets.label: **Data Migration & Pipelines**
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data migrations and API migrations that streamlined product and customer data flows, reducing migration effort and supporting smooth go-live for international roll-outs.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: Acted as the bridge between business and IT: analysed requirements, authored user stories and functional specs, and customised OCC REST services to meet sales-process needs.

bullets.label: **API Development & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Built robust OCC and REST APIs for headless commerce, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, guaranteeing reliable production operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany. Valid German residence and work permit. Serving notice; last working day 15.12.2026, earliest start 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your SAP C/4HANA initiatives.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Inhouse Consultant SAP C/4HANA Sales, Service, Marketing
cover_de.hook: Die Möglichkeit, digitale Vertriebs- und E-Commerce-Prozesse bei Intertime AG aktiv zu gestalten, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in der Integration von PIM, ERP und MDM sowie in der Optimierung globaler E-Commerce-Prozesse.

bullets.label: **Integrationsdesign**
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte komplexe Integrations-Pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) zur Synchronisation von Produktstammdaten zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und SAP Commerce, wodurch weltweite Storefronts konsistent betrieben werden konnten.

bullets.label: **Datenmigration & Pipelines**
bullets.text: Leitete PIM-zu-Hybris Datenmigrationen und API-Migrationsprojekte, die Produkt- und Kundendaten effizient in neue Systeme überführten und internationale Roll-outs unterstützten.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: Agierte als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und IT: analysierte Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und passte OCC-REST-Services an Vertriebsprozesse an.

bullets.label: **API-Entwicklung & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Entwickelte stabile OCC- und REST-APIs für Headless-Commerce und führte CI/CD-Deployments auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) mit Jenkins, Docker und Kubernetes durch, um einen reibungslosen Systembetrieb sicherzustellen.

cover_de.logistics: Standort Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzte Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meine Erfahrung für Ihre SAP-C/4HANA-Projekte einzubringen.

tailoring.why_company: Intertime AG stands out as an internationally oriented technology partner that invests in innovative SAP-C/4HANA projects. Your commitment to shaping global sales, service and marketing processes aligns perfectly with my experience in SAP Commerce Cloud integration and techno-functional consulting. I am eager to contribute to your expanding portfolio and grow within a forward-looking, collaborative environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud integration expertise to help Intertime AG modernise global sales and service processes within the SAP C/4HANA landscape.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Hannah, I’m a senior SAP Commerce Cloud consultant with 5+ years of integration and data-migration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to discuss how I can support Intertime AG’s SAP C/4HANA initiatives. Could we connect?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Inhouse Consultant SAP C/4HANA Sales, Service, Marketing
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Inhouse Consultant SAP C/4HANA position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, I am ready to contribute to Intertime AG’s digital sales and service transformation.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
